verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an integrations catalog covering cloud infrastructure, version control and identity providers, naming AWS (40+ resources), Azure, Okta and GitHub. That delivers the core of connecting a real stack. However, the evidence never mentions read-only scopes, and HR, ticketing and native MDM connectors are not shown in the catalog; MDM appears only as a category for API-built private integrations. missing for 10: documented read-only/least-privilege scopes, evidenced HR integrations, evidenced ticketing integrations, native MDM connectors, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Connect Vanta with your cloud infrastructure, version control, productivity tools, identity provider, and much more to give you a complete and automated view of your security and compliance.
Integrate with 40+ AWS resources to gather deep evidence of compliance and ensure your AWS infrastructure is secure.
integrates with [integrations_count] tools like AWS, Azure, Okta, GitHub, Wiz, and more
